task_text: I have a video call starting in 5 minutes. My desk area needs to look presentable and I should be able to see and hear clearly. The bedroom light is off.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare any light objects in the living room that need to be passed to R2 for the bedroom.
central_instructions.R2: Move to the bedroom to assist with passing objects between R3 and R4, and ensure the bedroom light is turned on.
central_instructions.R3: Prepare any light objects in the bedroom that need to be passed to R4 for organizing the desk area.
central_instructions.R4: Organize the desk area in the bedroom to make it presentable and ensure the light is turned on for the video call.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Identify any light objects in the living room that need to be passed to R2 for the bedroom. (r1_s1)
- R2 [ASK_HELP] Move to the living room to receive objects from R1. (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [PASS] Hand over identified light objects to R2. (r1_s2)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Collect light objects from R1 for the bedroom. (r2_s2)
- R2 [LOCAL] Move to the bedroom to place the objects and turn on the light. (r2_s3)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Move to the bedroom. (r2_s1)
- R2 [LOCAL] Turn on the bedroom light. (r2_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [HELP] Assist R3 and R4 with passing objects. (r2_s3)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Pick up the notebook from the desk. (r3_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Pick up the pen from the desk. (r3_s2)
- R3 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Pick up the phone from the desk. (r3_s3)
- R3 [PASS] PassReceiveObject: Pass the notebook to R4. (r3_s4)
- R3 [PASS] PassReceiveObject: Pass the pen to R4. (r3_s5)
- R3 [PASS] PassReceiveObject: Pass the phone to R4. (r3_s6)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [RECEIVE] PassReceiveObject: Receive the notebook from R3. (r4_s1)
- R4 [RECEIVE] PassReceiveObject: Receive the pen from R3. (r4_s2)
- R4 [RECEIVE] PassReceiveObject: Receive the phone from R3. (r4_s3)
- R4 [LOCAL] OrganizeDesk: Arrange the notebook, pen, and phone neatly on the desk. (r4_s4)
- R4 [LOCAL] TurnOnLight: Turn on the bedroom light for better visibility. (r4_s5)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Turn on the bedroom light to ensure good visibility for the video call. (r4_s1)
- R4 [LOCAL] Organize the desk by arranging any scattered items neatly and ensuring the laptop is centered. (r4_s2)
- R4 [LOCAL] Push the chair under the desk to create a tidy appearance. (r4_s3)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Ensure the area around the desk is clear of any clutter, such as moving the trash can if necessary. (r4_s4)
- R4 [LOCAL] Check the position of the lamp to ensure it provides adequate lighting for the video call. (r4_s5)
